exposure: 1% lignocaine hydrochloride for distal paravertebral nerve block
2% lignocaine hydrochloride for distal paravertebral nerve block
cohort: Full-term ewes (n = 18) with dystocia requiring laparohysterotomy (Caesarian section) were studied.
finding: Satisfactory flank anesthesia is achieved using either 2% or 1% lignocaine hydrochloride for distal paravertebral nerve block, validating the recommendation to use 1% local anesthetic for safety in small ruminants.
